line: History and archaeology mysteries read under a single lamp: real maps, aerial photographs and typeset sources rise out of the dark, one finding at a time, and sink back into it.
line_ja: 一灯の下で読む歴史ミステリー。地図・空中写真・史料が闇から浮かび、一つずつ確かめられ、また闇に沈む。
